headline: Old Monk Revenue Drops 64% Amid FSSAI Regulatory Disruptions
summary: Mohan Meakin, the manufacturer of Old Monk rum, reported a 64% revenue decline to ₹288 crore for the first half of the fiscal year, following production disruptions caused by FSSAI regulatory actions.
why: Regulatory compliance issues can severely impact the production and sales of consumer goods companies, leading to significant financial volatility.
